'''''Screamer''''' was the personal [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] so named after the [[teezl]] and used by [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] against the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]' [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Resurrector Squadron]] during the [[Second Battle of Endor]].
